title: Session Handoff Metadata
description: Between-session metadata for resuming work across multiple orchestration sessions. Output by the Orchestrator role.

sessionId.description: Unique identifier for this orchestration session (e.g., UUID, timestamp-based).

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this handoff was created.

lastSessionId.description: ID of the previous orchestration session (for traceability).

productSpecPath.description: Relative or absolute path to the current product-spec.json.

featureListPath.description: Relative or absolute path to the current feature-list.json.

completedSprints.description: List of sprints that have been completed and evaluated.

completedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this sprint was completed.

nextSprintNumber.description: Sprint number to execute in the next orchestration session.

nextSprintScope.description: Feature IDs planned for the next sprint (may be revised by next session's planner).

repositoryState.description: Snapshot of repository state for resume/replay.

lastGitCommit.description: Git commit SHA of the last known-good state.

isDirty.description: Whether the working tree has uncommitted changes.

activeFeatures.description: Features currently under development or pending evaluator approval.

knownIssues.description: Issues or blockers discovered in previous sessions that should be considered in the next session.

estimatedRemainingWork.description: Planner's estimate of remaining work (e.g., '3 features, ~2 weeks').

notes.description: Orchestrator notes for the next session (e.g., 'Consider increasing evaluator timeout' or 'Risk: Feature F-005 has complex dependencies').
